projects.title: Pengcheng Shennong
projects.description: AI-assisted targeted drug design and biomolecular research.
projects.descriptionZh: 智能化全链条靶向药物设计新范式。
projects.originalText: 传统制药流程需花费数十年数十亿美金，亟需提升设计效率。鹏程·神农开创了基于AI的靶向药物新范式，将候选药物的研发周期缩短到两个月以内。

projects.title: Running ahead of evolution
projects.description: AI-based simulation for predicting future high-risk SARS-CoV-2 variants. A joint project shortlisted for the 2022 ACM Gordon Bell Special Prize for HPC-Based COVID-19 Research.
projects.originalText: 北京大学深圳研究生院信息工程学院与鹏城实验室、山东大学组成的联合研究团队在自行研发的鹏程·神农生物信息研究平台上完成的“领先于病毒的进化——通过人工智能模拟预测未来高风险新冠病毒变异株”研究项目成功入围2022年度“戈登贝尔新冠特别奖”，也是本次入围的唯一来自中国团队的项目。

projects.title: MetaFold
projects.description: Protein structure prediction research using the Pengcheng Cloudbrain II AI computing cluster.
projects.originalText: MetaFold 蛋白质结构预测精度全球第一。利用“鹏城云脑II”AI计算集群，联合昌平&华为耗时数月打造MetaFold蛋白质结构预测AI模型。

datasets.title: BCData
datasets.subtitle: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Cell Detection and Counting
datasets.description: A dataset and benchmark for detecting and counting positive and negative tumor cells. Images and HDF5 coordinate annotations are divided into training, validation, and test splits.
datasets.loadingExample:
import h5py
import numpy as np

gt_path = "BCData/annotations/train/positive/10.h5"
with h5py.File(gt_path, "r") as gt_file:
    coordinates = np.asarray(gt_file["coordinates"])
